text: くそう…　おまえ　ロケットだんを　なめてるな！

structure.jp: ロケットだんを　なめてるな！
structure.en: are underestimating Team Rocket, aren't you!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. なめてる = 'are underestimating'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirming)
patterns.explanation: な at the end of a statement is a rough way of saying 'aren't you' or 'I see'. なめてるな = 'you're underestimating us, aren't you'.
